ImageDescription.value:
This was taken from the rear of the mesh backstop of the baseball diamond on the east side of the Great Lawn in Central Park. The view is to the west, with a couple of the tall apartment buildings of Central Park West in the background.

Note: this photo was published in an Aug 30, 2009 Twin Falls Examiner article titled "Bicycle photography of Ed Yourdon-New York candids." It was also published in a Jan 8, 2010 blog titled "Central Park by bike."

These pictures were taken during a mid-day stroll through Central Park on a mostly-sunny Saturday afternoon. It was mostly an experiment to see how well the GPS feature on my new Nikon Coolpix P6000 worked.... but it also gave me a chance to get used to the camera itself.
